title: Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft are expected to report double-digit gains in revenue this week, as investors grow impatient with AI capex and seek returns (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft are expected to report double-digit gains in revenue this week, as investors grow impatient with AI capex and seek returns — Three of the biggest and most important technology companies in the world are expected to show healthy growth when they report earnings this week.
